releases.notes: Project source is now MIT licensed; upstream dependencies and vendored terminal notices retain their own licenses. Documentation names components by responsibility, adds the feature matrix and uses public examples. Packaging and documentation metadata only; runtime, worker and host protocols, catalog schema and reader floor, guest kernel, host layout and stage 0 are unchanged. Keep all running service pins; no restart, transfer, store activation, infrastructure change or guest-state change is required.

Explicit owner-operated runner draining, protected-by-default eligibility, immutable named snapshot publication and sealed empty certificates bound to fresh worker process/boot identity, authenticated node generation and catalog placement/transfer revisions. Schema 6 / reader floor 6 requires a private catalog backup and coordinated catalog-reader upgrade; prior writers are refused. Reuses installed protocol-2/3 export and source-only cleanup; worker protocol 3 (agent readers 1-3), runtime, guest kernel and host layout 2 remain unchanged. Retain running worker pins. No automatic drain on installation, running-workstation migration, provider destruction, new capacity, timer or implicit cold-memory loss. Retained dev-disk evidence and certificate consumption are separate operator gates.

waivers.host-layout: Only deploy/aws/host/test_upgrade.py adds an integration regression preserving the independent retirement seal when upgrade drain clears; no unit, layout or host installer behavior changes.

releases.notes: Explicit move and targeted cross-runner fork through durable catalog intents, immutable artifact jobs, prepared imports and conditional commit. Move preserves physical ID, owner/grants and pinned SSH policy; fork refreshes guest/network/SSH identity and belongs to its requester. Explicit pre-commit cancellation/retarget excludes unstarted targets and uses a fresh epoch; post-commit uncertainty stays pinned for forward recovery. Worker interface 3 adds child preparation, durable target exclusion, serialized prepared SSH policy and running-source registration; managed child/exclusion state uses reader-guarded worker state schema 3. Agents accept worker interfaces 1-3; older workers remain fixed-placement and cannot advertise move/fork. Catalog schema/reader floor 5, host protocol 1, runtime, guest kernel and host layout 2 are unchanged. Use the class-2 quiesce/swap/resume upgrade with compatibility checks and explicit cold-memory-loss consent on dedicated eligible runners; no automatic box movement, cold resize, timer, host replacement or infrastructure activation.

Explicit park and coalesced wake through durable catalog transfers and the single fenced hibernation publication scheduler. Park preserves stopped versus hibernated state and releases placement only after verified durable publication; connections wake hibernated boxes, while stopped boxes require explicit start. Warm wake filters the captured runtime, CPU and guest-kernel tuple before reserving a runner. Public host asset downloads hash each opened file instead of trusting metadata cache hits; repeated GET/HEAD requests also incur verification cost. Update controller, dashboard, agents and remote clients; requires the already-installed worker interface 2 placement fences. Catalog schema and reader floor 5, node protocol 1, worker interface 2, runtime, guest kernel and host layout are unchanged from v0.9.10. Retain running worker pins; no worker restart, automatic parking policy, timer, host replacement or implicit cold-memory loss.

waivers.worker: crates/ow/src/host.rs only rejects park/wake in the operator-local CLI and classifies Store as controller-only. Worker dispatch, runtime and lifecycle behavior are unchanged. Retain the worker pin.

releases.notes: Opt-in catalog-rooted artifact GC adds exact dry-run candidates, terminal tombstones, atomic root/grace revalidation, resumable versioned deletion receipts, live-object verification and a break-glass undo plan. Update the controller and dashboard for shared catalog validation; optional scoped GC IAM/config is class 0. Live deletion requires complete catalog authority, effective policy and undo evidence. Catalog schema/reader floor 5, host protocol 1, worker interface 2/readers 1-2, runtime, guest kernel, host layout 2 and stage 0 are unchanged from v0.9.8. Existing worker pins and running guests are preserved; no worker restart, automatic GC timer, bucket replacement or infrastructure activation.

waivers.worker: crates/ow/src/host.rs only adds Action::Store to the unreachable local-operator command arm. main.rs dispatches store commands before host::run; worker dispatch, runtime, placement enforcement and worker interfaces are unchanged. Keep the worker pin unchanged.

releases.notes: Opt-in controller-only host reuses the node listener, persistent catalog, dashboard and catalog backup without KVM, a local worker or implicit local capacity. Dormant dashboard pins follow catalog-reader upgrades while only installed services restart. Class 1 new-role packaging; class 0 component/config impact on unaffected existing hosts. Catalog schema and reader floor 5, node protocol 1, worker interface 2, runtime, guest kernel, host layout 2 and stage 0 are unchanged from v0.9.7. Existing combined host and runner defaults, credentials, Tailscale state and worker pins are preserved. No worker restart, automatic movement, failover or infrastructure creation.

Verified bounded cache inventory, lease-excluded and replay-safe eviction, aggregate staging reservations and deterministic cache-aware placement. Update controller, dashboard and agents, then use the normal class-2 worker quiesce/hibernate/swap/resume action; a control-plane update alone cannot grant older workers cache enforcement. The acknowledged cache-inventory-v1 extension and worker cache_eviction_v1 capability gate the new shape and operations. Preserve full logical disk reservations, configured host/capture reserves, capture compatibility and explicit cold-memory-loss consent. Catalog schema/read floor 5, host protocol 1, worker interface 2/readers 1-2, runtime, guest kernel, host layout and stage0 remain unchanged from v0.9.4. No host replacement, automatic managed movement or store activation.

Durable managed restore of catalog-authorized artifacts with digest and lineage validation, reserved capacity, unstarted import, conditional placement commit and activation. Controller, agent and remote client update; requires the existing worker interface 2 placement fences. Catalog schema 5 and reader floor 5, protocols, runtime, guest kernel and host layout are unchanged from v0.9.4. Retain running worker pins; no worker restart, host replacement, automatic movement, source-loss takeover or implicit cold-memory loss. Managed lifecycle replies and inventory reconcile only with the committed placement; durable transfer recovery is covered by controller and agent process-kill tests.

waivers.worker: crates/ow/src/host.rs only rejects managed artifact restore in the operator-local CLI path; worker dispatch, runtime and lifecycle behavior are unchanged.

releases.notes: Named not-found errors for catalog lookups in the remote CLI and dashboard, with HTTP 404 and CLI exit 1. Retains actionable running-box delete and missing SSH key guidance. Class 1 control-plane update only: catalog schema 5 and reader floor 5, host and worker protocols, runtime, guest kernel and host layout are unchanged from v0.9.3. Retain running worker pins; no worker restart, host replacement, automatic movement or recovery/store activation.

waivers.host-layout: Only deploy/aws/host/test_upgrade.py adds a catalog-upgrade regression; host rendering, units and runtime host layout are unchanged.

releases.notes: Persisted placement authority, transfer intent and capacity reservations. Catalog schema 5 requires reader floor 5: take a private consistent backup and move controller, dashboard and agent catalog readers together. Worker interface 2, host protocol 1, runtime, guest kernel and host layout are unchanged from v0.9.2; retain running worker pins. Transfer execution remains dormant. Older catalog writers are refused; rollback after new writes requires a current compatible catalog. No automatic movement, source reactivation, cold-memory loss or recovery/store activation.

Opt-in consistent running recovery points and upload after ten sealed hibernated minutes, verified incremental SnapshotStore chunks, persistent durability/failure/retry status in CLI and dashboard, and retained data volumes. Use the normal class-2 worker hibernate/swap/resume path and update the dashboard; timer/configuration defaults off and never restarts the worker. Failed unsealed running intents yield to later sleep captures while sealed uploads retain their identity. Catalog schema4/reader floor3, worker interface2/readers1-2, host-runner protocol, runtime, kernel, host layout and stage0 are unchanged. Legacy snapshot transport remains supported; RAM continuation still requires compatible captures. No host replacement or automatic recovery/store activation.

Opt-in write-once S3 artifacts, digest-pinned name@N images and controller-selected image builds. Additive catalog schema 4 retains schema 3 SQL read/write compatibility; copy the catalog before moving controller and dashboard. Worker selectors and image digest metadata require the normal class 2 hibernate/swap/resume cycle. Retains worker interface 2 with agent readers 1-2 and dormant managed-copy fencing from v0.8.6; host transport, runtime, kernel, legacy SnapshotStore and stage 0 stay compatible. Preserve capture checks and explicit cold-memory-loss consent; no host replacement or automatic store activation.

Dormant managed-workspace placement fences and replay-safe local export, prepared import, activation and source-only cleanup. Worker interface 2; new agents accept workers 1-2 and legacy workers remain fixed-placement. Managed worker state refuses legacy readers; catalog schema, host transport, runtime, guest kernel and host layout are unchanged. Use class-2 quiesce/swap/resume with compatibility and explicit cold-loss gates; controller and agent envelope changes are class 1. Movement remains inactive pending catalog authority and artifact-store integration. Snapshot reservations, cached delete replies and cleaned-copy admission retain their tested replay and compatibility boundaries.

Configurable 1:1 or 2:1 Linux vCPU admission through guided enrollment and AWS Host/Runner configuration. Default remains 1:1; memory, disk, slots and owner quotas are unchanged. Applying an AWS ratio changes worker and controller budgets together under class-2 warm restart controls; no host replacement, new capacity or autoscaling. Runtime and capture compatibility unchanged.

Remote CLI discovery reports selected server, identity, prepared images and admission headroom with honest unknown/offline capacity. Worker and agent add optional disk reservation/headroom and box-count observations; controller exposes bounded authenticated metadata and safe first-use errors. Existing JSON, raw exec exit/output and operation-key retries remain compatible. Protocols, catalog schema, runtime, images and host layout are unchanged; use the normal warm worker upgrade and preserve cold-memory-loss gates.

Capability-based tailnet admission through optional dashboardCapability and fresh Tailscale whois grants, with stable user ownership and terminal/SSH/preview stream revocation. In-place host config carries the capability and preserves preview helpers for capability-only dashboards. Upgrade the dashboard and apply host configuration; worker, controller, protocols, catalog schema, guest images, snapshot format, host layout v2 and stage 0 are unchanged. No instance replacement is required.

Controller admission limits for provisioned owner CPU, RAM, logical root disks and box count, with private administrator overrides and a priced pool capacity forecast. Policy reloads require no restart; the controller and gateway upgrade independently of the worker. No worker, host-runner interface, snapshot format, guest image or host replacement change; existing boxes stay running.

Combined snapshot admission/error recovery and tailnet-only HTTP/WebSocket previews. One necessary warm worker upgrade for capture fixes; controller/dashboard/agents provide private per-box origins using existing sharing grants. No protocol, snapshot format, guest image or host replacement change. Preserve capture compatibility and cold-memory-loss gates.

Capture admission reserves new RAM and host headroom without reserving the existing disk again. Failed captures clean staging, named limits exclude internal captures, and failed operation causes persist with safe client guidance. Worker move uses normal hibernate/resume; no guest disk migration or cold boot is required.

Retry direct Tailscale route probes while networkd acquires DHCP after reconfiguration. A transient unreachable route uses the existing bounded readiness wait; persistent failure still refuses setup and leaves work pending. Stage 0 and service pins are unchanged.

Fresh host bootstrap: allow the Tailscale package install to wait up to five minutes for the dpkg frontend lock instead of failing on concurrent OS package maintenance. Real package errors still fail bootstrap; stage 0 and running units are unchanged.
Optional direct Tailscale path: secondary public interface and Elastic IP, UDP 41641 only, networkd policy routing and daemon port pin. Host, worker and boxes stay running; stage 0 is unchanged.
Owner-requested sparse root disk sizing and stopped-box growth; ext4 expands before cold boot. Existing disks and paired warm snapshots keep their sizes. Class 2 runner upgrade, no host replacement.
Operator helper: select role-aware readiness after first boot installs ow-host, so fresh runner-only hosts do not wait for a controller port. Existing host services and boxes are unchanged.

SSH proxy throughput: readiness-driven client and node streams; actionable running-box delete and SSH enrollment errors. Update clients as well as controller, agent and dashboard. Worker, guest images and protocols are unchanged; no host replacement required.
Component fix: `pulumi package add` failed on 0.6.0 (Runner not found). Runner extends ComponentResource itself and takes its controller as { hostName, roleName }. Hosts are unchanged.

waivers.worker: crates/ow/src/host.rs changes only `ow node agent` (a runner host's agent drains on SIGTERM), not the worker

releases.notes: Runner component: a runner host joins an existing controller (#24). Controller, agent and host-layout changes; the worker is unchanged, so boxes keep running.
Host layout v2: config in an SSM parameter, worker and control plane in separate units, release directories with per-unit pins, ow-host upgrade. One planned replacement moves a 0.4.x host to it.
Baseline: every release replaces the host.
